name: nexo-frontend
description: Nexo - controle de custos e pessoas
author: Leandro Mathias

scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ELECTRON_START_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 node electron/dev-launch.cjs"
scripts.desktop:dev:demo: concurrently -k "cross-env VITE_DEMO_MODE=true vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ELECTRON_START_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 node electron/dev-launch.cjs"
scripts.desktop:build:demo: cross-env VITE_DEMO_MODE=true npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.desktop:portable:demo: cross-env VITE_DEMO_MODE=true npm run build && electron-builder --win portable
scripts.desktop:publish: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --publish always
